name: v0.3.12 nested-hub parent preservation
one_shot_semantics: After this protocol commit and the later candidate-freeze commit, run the 18-cell mechanism matrix once. Rerun only an exact cell that fails for infrastructure reasons. Do not change the candidate, budgets, seeds, or CRM/Ops targets after seeing outcomes.
research_question: Can a minimal parameter-free nested-hub preservation rule prevent active outer sequences from being prematurely terminated as lost_parent, allowing them to reach horizon/return without breaking the proven return-cycle safety behavior?
success_means: Protocol integrity and reproducible evidence, not a fresh-generalization claim.

inspected_mechanism_cases.name: buggy-crm
inspected_mechanism_cases.role: frozen v0.3.11 target, now a mechanism-development case

inspected_mechanism_cases.name: buggy-ops
inspected_mechanism_cases.role: frozen v0.3.11 target, now a mechanism-development case

when_all: chosen action is a branch click
an outer sequence instance is open
do: record the nested hub and nested branch discovery
record that the branch action was traversed
count the action inside the outer sequence
continue normal relation, finding, crash, and horizon logic
keep v0.3.9 exact-signature return-cycle escape once return phase begins
do_not: emit sequence_terminal outcome=lost_parent for the outer instance
emit branch_start for a new sequence instance
increment sequence_instances_started for the nested click
semantic_rule.ledger_policy: Discover the nested branch and mark it observed in candidate-only nested-followup accounting. Increment the structural attempt counter so the branch is not left looking never-tried. Do not add it to BranchRec.started and do not open a sequence instance.
semantic_rule.avoided_preemption_relation: Each nested_branch_followup is one avoided commitment-window lost_parent. The two counters increment together. Neither is a return success.

return_cycle_guard_semantics.rule: During an unresolved return phase, the first repeated exact destination signature before the recorded parent matches is a return cycle.
return_cycle_guard_semantics.escape: Abandon the return obligation. Do not count returned or completed.

detector.rule: A nested-hub preemption is an open sequence terminated lost_parent at a hub branch click before that instance has emitted sequence_horizon_reached or return_attempt.
detector.commitment_window: The pre-after step ledger shows returning false and commitment_left > 0.
detector.historical_expectation: CRM and Ops guard evidence contain commitment-window preemptions and zero return phase. Wiki reaches horizon and return, with fewer preemptions than CRM or Ops. Counts are not hardcoded in the detector.

matrix.seed_rationale: Deterministic policies. v0.3.11 already records BFS/DFS context. Do not change budgets after the outcome.

all: historical G evidence contains at least one detected nested-hub preemption
N emits nested_branch_followup for that mechanism class
N has zero commitment-window lost_parent terminals
N reaches sequence_horizon_reached or a finding/crash terminal after a preserved follow-up
N reaches return phase: return_attempt_events > 0 OR sequence_instances_returned > 0 OR return_cycle_escape_events > 0
N states > G states OR N normalized URLs > G URLs

safety_tests.N1: nested branch click does not emit lost_parent; outer instance, branch, and parent remain; nested_branch_followup is emitted
safety_tests.N2: commitment_left decreases by the normal step and is not reset to BRANCH_HORIZON
safety_tests.N3: enough follow-up actions reach sequence_horizon_reached and returning becomes true
safety_tests.N4: return still targets the original outer parent and counts exactly once
safety_tests.N5: exact A-B-A repeat before the parent yields one escape and no returned/completed inflation
safety_tests.N6: no open outer instance: branch_start matches the historical controller
safety_tests.N7: commitment_left <= 0 or returning true: preservation does not invent a commitment; behavior matches the historical controller
safety_tests.N8: finding during a nested follow-up emits one finding terminal; a later cycle escape is L2 with no second terminal
safety_tests.N9: crash during a nested follow-up stays a single auditable crash terminal
safety_tests.N10: the nested branch is visible in events and metrics and does not start an independent sequence
safety_tests.N11: a repeated visit to the same nested hub does not reset parent or commitment
safety_tests.S1_S7: existing direct return, multi-step return, same-cluster variants, self-loop, A-B-A, history reset, finding-then-cycle
safety_tests.exhaustive: bounded return model, at least 5800 traces, zero failures, on the historical guard and on this candidate
safety_tests.differential: traces with no commitment-window nested hub branch click match v0.3.9 guard behavior

A.label: mechanism repaired, regression-safe
all: exhaustive return-cycle model check has zero failures and at least 5800 traces
zero commitment-window lost_parent remains on the candidate
no confirmed bug loss versus the historical guard on Wiki, BuggyDesk, BuggyShop, and DeepBench
A.interpretation: nested-hub preemption repaired on the two inspected mechanism cases, without historical regression

B.label: partial mechanism repair
B.when: Safety and historical bug regression pass, but only one of CRM or Ops fully repairs, or both remove the commitment-window preemption and at least one still fails to reach return or expand.

C.label: harmful/regression
any: exhaustive failure or fewer than 5800 traces
confirmed bug loss on any regression case

D.label: no demonstrated effect / mechanism mismatch
D.when: Safety holds, and either the detector cannot reproduce historical preemption on the mechanism cases, or the candidate does not eliminate the commitment-window preemption on either CRM or Ops.
D.not: Do not reinterpret D as B or A.

outcome_gates.priority: C, then D, then A, else B
